thread:
Leah: Hi team — I'm starting today! Quick Q: who currently owns provisioning for laptop/Okta/AWS project access and who covers oncall escalations my first two weeks? Trying to make a checklist so I don't accidentally page the wrong person.
Sam: welcome! :tada: For hardware/Okta open a ticket with people-ops (people-ops@redwood). Infra-level cloud creds are handled by infra-oncall — ping #eng-infra for non-urgent, page infra-oncall for urgent.
Anna: For repo access, CI bits, and k8s namespaces ping me (anna). I handle repo perms and team group invites.
Marco: Runtime/Dedicated questions (deploys, model capacity) live with eng-runtime. I'm on rotation this week — DM me and I can triage. If it’s impacting prod latency, page @eng-oncall.
Leah: awesome, can you confirm the flow? people-ops -> anna -> infra-oncall -> eng-oncall? want a simple linear path.
Sam: that's a good short path. Formal escalation is: people-ops (identity/hardware) -> infra-oncall (cloud infra, IAM) -> eng-oncall (prod incidents) -> eng-sre (post-incident follow-up). For non-urgent access, file the ticket and tag approvers.
devex-bot: Reminder: new-hire checklist at https://intranet.redwood.com/new-hire-checklist — hardware tickets typically 3-5 business days.
Leah: thanks — any tips for getting access to the Dedicated dashboard and cost reports?
Anna: send me the email you'll use and I'll add you to groups 'dedicated-read' and 'rdw-billing'. Also enable the SSO app 'Redwood Console' in Okta once people-ops completes onboarding.
Marco: if you need to exercise inference endpoints, we have a staging API key in the team vault. I'll grant you access — then run `vault read secret/redwood/staging-api-key` after you have vault perms.
Leah: important: who should I CC if a customer-facing demo flops? don't want to surprise folks.
Sam: for demos, CC product-support and eng-time-of-day. If it's customer-impacting outage, page eng-oncall and @support-lead immediately.
Anna: process tip — if it’s a permission or UI issue blocking access, include the failing URL and a screenshot in the ticket; that speeds triage.
Leah: got it, thanks! I'll file the tickets today and ping back here when they're done.
Marco: +1 — ping me when you want the staging key or if you want me to join the onboarding call.
Sam: welcome aboard again, see you at the intro sync at 2pm. :wave:
